blind.description: A free-standing decorative stone pillar/column featuring a flat square capstone, a capital carved with human skulls facing outward from each side, a central shaft wrapped in stylized bone rings and ribs over a smooth dark stone core, and a stepped square base with crossed bones on a dark tier. Surfaces are continuous, solid, and clean without shards, spikes, blobs, holes, or floating flakes. Nothing is melted or detached. It stands upright on its own square architectural base, sitting flat on the floor. Materials consist of tan/sandstone and bone-colored stone with contrasting smooth dark charcoal stone on the recessed shaft and plinth. No flame or glow.
blind.from_above: A flat square stone slab with beveled edges, with the carved skull crowns subtly protruding at the midpoint of each edge, casting a diagonal pillar shadow.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 10 ft tall (roughly 1.7 to 1.8 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure), and about 3.5 ft wide (roughly twice the width of the figure).
